mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM promotion_groups_team_member m LEFT JOIN orders_associations o ON m.order_id = o.order_id

SELECT m.id AS m_id, m.team_id AS m_team_id, m.company_id AS m_company_id, m.act_id AS m_act_id, m.member_id AS m_member_id, m.join_time AS m_join_time, m.order_id AS m_order_id, m.group_goods_type AS m_group_goods_type, m.member_info AS m_member_info, m.disabled AS m_disabled, o.order_id AS o_order_id, o.authorizer_appid AS o_authorizer_appid, o.wxa_appid AS o_wxa_appid, o.title AS o_title, o.total_fee AS o_total_fee, o.company_id AS o_company_id, o.shop_id AS o_shop_id, o.store_name AS o_store_name, o.user_id AS o_user_id, o.promoter_user_id AS o_promoter_user_id, o.promoter_shop_id AS o_promoter_shop_id, o.source_id AS o_source_id, o.monitor_id AS o_monitor_id, o.mobile AS o_mobile, o.order_class AS o_order_class, o.order_type AS o_order_type, o.order_status AS o_order_status, o.is_distribution AS o_is_distribution, o.total_rebate AS o_total_rebate, o.delivery_corp AS o_delivery_corp, o.delivery_code AS o_delivery_code, o.delivery_time AS o_delivery_time, o.member_discount AS o_member_discount, o.coupon_discount AS o_coupon_discount, o.coupon_discount_desc AS o_coupon_discount_desc, o.member_discount_desc AS o_member_discount_desc, o.delivery_status AS o_delivery_status, o.cancel_status AS o_cancel_status, o.create_time AS o_create_time, o.end_time AS o_end_time, o.update_time AS o_update_time, o.fee_type AS o_fee_type, o.fee_rate AS o_fee_rate, o.fee_symbol AS o_fee_symbol, o.salesman_id AS o_salesman_id FROM promotion_groups_team_member m LEFT JOIN orders_associations o ON m.order_id = o.order_id
ORDER BY m.join_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM promotion_groups_team_member m INNER JOIN service_orders so ON so.company_id = m.company_id AND so.order_id = CAST(m.order_id AS UNSIGNED) WHERE m.company_id = #{companyId} AND m.team_id = #{teamId} AND m.disabled = 0 AND m.order_id IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(m.order_id) != '' AND TRIM(m.order_id) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$' AND so.order_status IN ('PAYED', 'WAIT_BUYER_CONFIRM', 'DONE') AND so.update_time IS NOT NULL AND so.update_time > #{teamEndTimeSeconds}

SELECT t.act_id AS actId, t.end_time AS endTime, m.team_id AS teamId, m.member_id AS memberId, m.order_id AS orderId, tr.time_expire AS timeExpire FROM promotion_groups_team_member m LEFT JOIN trade tr ON m.order_id = tr.order_id INNER JOIN promotion_groups_team t ON m.team_id = t.team_id WHERE tr.trade_state = 'SUCCESS' AND (tr.time_expire + 0) > t.end_time AND m.member_id > 0 AND (m.disabled = 0 OR m.disabled IS NULL)
AND 1 = 0
